title: The Book of Mormon (2 1 Ne. 30:9 especially) and the Doctrine and Covenants (113) reinforce the fact that Jesus Christ is the main character in Isa. 11. He is the Messiah who will have the "spirit of the Lord," the "spirit of wisdom and understanding," "counsel and might," "knowledge," and "fear of the Lord" (11:2); he is the Messiah who will serve as the righteous judge (11:3); and he will be the advocate of the poor and the meek and will settle their case (11:4). In the end, the Messiah will smite the wicked of the earth with his great power at the Second Coming, resulting in the glorious conditions of the Millennium (11:6-10).
author: Tina M. Peterson
